children: Granite Point Mortgage Trust expanded and refined its JPMorgan repurchase facility through two amendments effective Sep 30, 2026. The master repurchase agreement and fee letter were amended to raise the uncommitted capacity to $727.0 million and adjust principal payment waterfalls for newly added assets. Separately, the company amended its guarantee agreement to modify the Minimum Interest Expense Coverage Ratio. The newly added purchased assets were previously financed under facilities with Citibank and Morgan Stanley. The updates are intended to consolidate financing, enhance liquidity, and provide added covenant flexibility.
